description: This file contains template class definitions for a Queue and QueueNode, implementing a simple linked list queue with methods for enqueue, dequeue, clear, and map. It is part of Google Test samples demonstrating C++ testing framework usage.

classes.name: Queue
classes.description: A template class implementing a linked list queue with methods for managing queue elements.

classes.name: QueueNode
classes.description: A template class representing a node in the queue, holding an element and a pointer to the next node.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the queue, deleting nodes.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the queue.

methods.name: Head
methods.description: Returns the first node in the queue.

methods.name: Last
methods.description: Returns the last node in the queue.

methods.name: Enqueue
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the queue.

methods.name: Dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the element at the front of the queue.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Applies a function to each element and returns a new queue with the results.
